#include <iostream>

#include <cstdio>
#include <algorithm>

#include <map>

#define prfi(x) printf("%d\n",x);
#define sfi(X) scanf("%d",&X);
#define lop(i,n) for (int i = 0 ; i < n ;i++)
#define blop(i,n) for(int i = n-1 ; i>=0;i--)
#define M_P make_pair
#define All(X) (X).begin(),(X).end()
#define SZ(n) (int)(n).size()
#define voi vector<int>
#define Allr(X) (X).rbegin(),(X).rend()
#define vos vector<string>
#define vob vector<bool>
#define vovi vector<vector<int > >
#define vob vector<bool>
#define ll long long 
using namespace std;

int gcd(int a, int b)
{
	return b ? gcd(b, a%b) : a;
}
int main()
{
	int x, y, limit;
	scanf("%d%d%d", &x, &y, &limit);
	double maxDiff = 1e9;
	int answer1, answer2;
	for (int i = 1; i <= limit; i++)
	{
		int b = (x * i) / y;
		double a = (double)b / i;
		double a1 = (abs(b - 1)) / i;
		double a2 = (b + 1) / i;
		if (fabs(x / (double)y - a) < maxDiff)
		{
			answer1 = b, answer2 = i;
			maxDiff = fabs(x / (double)y - a);
		}
		if (fabs(x / (double)y - a1) < maxDiff)
		{
			answer1 = abs(b-1), answer2 = i;
			maxDiff = fabs(x / (double)y - a1);
		}
		if (fabs(x / (double)y - a2) < maxDiff)
		{
			answer1 = b+1, answer2 = i;
			maxDiff = fabs(x / (double)y - a2);
		}
	}
	if (fabs(1.0 - x / (double)y) <= fabs((double)answer1 / answer2 - x / (double)y) + 1e-9 )
		answer1 = 1, answer2 = 1;
	int gcdValue = gcd(answer1, answer2);
	printf("%d/%d\n", answer1 / gcdValue, answer2 / gcdValue);
}
